classes/battlesmith-725.name: Battlesmith
prerequisites: Special:Must have created a dwarvencraft weapon and used it in battle
classes/battlesmith-725.proficiencyText: Battlesmiths gain no proficiency with any weapon or armor.

proficiencyReview.note: The class explicitly grants no weapon or armor proficiencies.

levelGrants.name: One with the Hammer
levelGrants.description: When wielding a warhammer she crafted herself, the battlesmith adds her Wisdom bonus to weapon damage.

levelGrants.name: Secrets of the Forge
levelGrants.description: The battlesmith gains Craft Magic Arms and Armor without needing its caster-level prerequisite. For crafting magic arms and armor, her effective caster level is three times her battlesmith level and stacks with other caster levels; all other item prerequisites still apply.

levelGrants.name: Flesh of My Flesh
levelGrants.description: While wearing heavy armor she crafted herself, the battlesmith gains a +1 sacred AC bonus, increasing to +2 at 4th level.

levelGrants.name: Forged in Fire
levelGrants.description: The battlesmith can ignore the effects of fatigue and exhaustion for a number of hours equal to her class level; if the condition remains afterward, its effects resume.

levelGrants.name: Flesh of My Flesh
levelGrants.description: While wearing heavy armor she crafted herself, the battlesmith gains a +2 sacred AC bonus.

levelGrants.name: Tempered in Blood
levelGrants.description: Once per day when aware of a damaging melee weapon or natural attack and able to react, the battlesmith may attempt a Fortitude save (DC 10 + damage dealt) to take half damage. The ability is unavailable when she is denied her Dexterity bonus to AC.

classes/duelist-768.name: Duelist
classes/duelist-768.sourceBook: Sword and Fist: A Guidebook to Monks and Fighters
classes/duelist-768.proficiencyText: The Sword and Fist duelist is proficient with simple and martial weapons and the buckler, but gains no armor proficiency.

proficiencyReview.note: Verified against the Sword and Fist Duelist on pages 17-18; this is the 3.0 source record, not the later Dungeon Master's Guide 3.5 Duelist.

levelGrants.name: Canny Defense
levelGrants.description: While unarmored and wielding a melee weapon, the duelist adds her Intelligence bonus to her Dexterity bonus to AC; the bonus is lost whenever her Dexterity bonus is denied.

levelGrants.name: Precise Strike
levelGrants.description: With a one-handed piercing weapon and no weapon attacking in the other hand, the duelist deals +1d6 precision damage to living creatures with discernible anatomies. The bonus rises by +1d6 every four duelist levels thereafter.

levelGrants.name: Enhanced Mobility
levelGrants.description: While unarmored, the duelist gains +4 AC against attacks of opportunity caused by moving out of or within a threatened area.

levelGrants.name: Grace
levelGrants.description: While unarmored, the duelist gains a +2 competence bonus on Reflex saves.

levelGrants.name: Acrobatic Attack
levelGrants.description: After jumping or swinging at least 5 feet into an attack, the duelist gains +2 on the attack and damage rolls, subject to the required movement check.

levelGrants.name: Precise Strike
levelGrants.description: Precise Strike increases to +2d6.

levelGrants.name: Elaborate Parry
levelGrants.description: When fighting defensively or using all-out defense in melee, the duelist gains an additional dodge bonus to AC equal to her duelist class level.

levelGrants.name: Improved Reaction
levelGrants.description: The duelist gains a +2 bonus on initiative rolls that stacks with Improved Initiative.

levelGrants.name: Deflect Arrows
levelGrants.description: The duelist gains the benefit of Deflect Arrows while using a one-handed piercing weapon.

levelGrants.name: Precise Strike
levelGrants.description: Precise Strike increases to +3d6.

classes/goliath-liberator-732.name: Goliath Liberator
prerequisites: Special:Must have participated in the successful rescue of captives held by giants, or have been imprisoned by giants and escaped
classes/goliath-liberator-732.proficiencyText: Goliath liberators gain proficiency with martial weapons and with light and medium armor.

levelGrants.name: Favored Enemy (Giant)
levelGrants.description: The liberator gains +2 on specified skills and weapon damage against giants; the bonus stacks with an existing favored enemy (giants) bonus and increases to +4 at 5th level.

levelGrants.name: Avoid Thrown Weapons
levelGrants.description: The liberator gains a +2 dodge bonus to AC against thrown weapons.

levelGrants.name: Equal Footing
levelGrants.description: The liberator gains Improved Trip as a bonus feat without meeting its prerequisites and gains +4 on the Strength check to trip a creature at least one size category larger.

levelGrants.name: Avoid Reach
levelGrants.description: The liberator gains a +2 dodge bonus to AC against melee attacks made by creatures that are not adjacent to her.

levelGrants.name: Favored Enemy (Giant)
levelGrants.description: Favored Enemy (Giant) increases to +4.

classes/ghost-slayer-525.name: Ghost Slayer
prerequisites: Feats:Incorporeal Target Fighting or Incorporeal Spell Targeting
Special:Must have been knocked unconscious by or failed a saving throw against an attack from a ghost; a character who is a ghost cannot take this class
classes/ghost-slayer-525.proficiencyText: Ghost slayers gain no proficiency with any weapons, armor, or shields.

levelGrants.name: Untainted Spirit
levelGrants.description: The ghost slayer is immune to all forms of possession.

levelGrants.name: Silver Aura
levelGrants.description: The ghost slayer's melee weapons and unarmed strikes are treated as silver for purposes of stunning a ghost with a successful critical hit or sneak attack.

levelGrants.name: Protected Vessel
levelGrants.description: The ghost slayer gains +3 on saves against ghost powers and reduces ability damage or drain caused by ghost powers by 1 per attack, to a minimum of 0.

levelGrants.name: Detect Ghost
levelGrants.description: The ghost slayer can use detect ghost at will as a spell-like ability.

levelGrants.name: Ghost Touch Aura
levelGrants.description: As a move-equivalent action, the ghost slayer can give a chosen weapon the ghost touch property for 1 round; this ability is usable at will.

levelGrants.name: Ghost Bane Fires
levelGrants.description: As a free action, the ghost slayer can give a chosen weapon the ghost bane property for 1 round. Daily uses equal ghost slayer class level plus Charisma modifier.

classes/gladiator-771.name: Gladiator
classes/gladiator-771.sourceBook: Sword and Fist: A Guidebook to Monks and Fighters
prerequisites: Feats:At least two feats from the fighter bonus feat list
classes/gladiator-771.proficiencyText: The Sword and Fist Gladiator class features contain no Weapon and Armor Proficiency grant.

proficiencyReview.note: Sword and Fist page 21 proceeds from the Gladiator class skills directly to Class Features: Improved Feint; there is no Weapon and Armor Proficiency class feature to grant additional training.

levelGrants.name: Improved Feint
levelGrants.description: The gladiator can use the feinting-in-combat Bluff technique as a move-equivalent action.

levelGrants.name: Study Opponent
levelGrants.description: After using all-out defense, the gladiator gains a dodge bonus against an opponent that attacks him in melee; the bonus starts the following round and lasts for the fight.

levelGrants.name: Exhaust Opponent
levelGrants.description: After attacking the same opponent for three consecutive rounds, the gladiator can force a Fortitude save against subdual damage from exhaustion; the DC rises each continued round and resets if he does not attack for a round.

levelGrants.name: Roar of the Crowd
levelGrants.description: With at least six noncombatant spectators, the gladiator may make a DC 15 Perform check as a move-equivalent action to gain +1 morale on attacks and damage for the fight.

levelGrants.name: Study Opponent
levelGrants.description: Study Opponent's dodge bonus increases to +2.

levelGrants.name: Improved Coup de Grace
levelGrants.description: The gladiator can deliver a melee coup de grace as a standard action, or take a full-round showy version to gain a +2 morale attack bonus for the rest of the combat.

levelGrants.name: Poison Use
levelGrants.description: The gladiator is trained in poison use.

levelGrants.name: Study Opponent
levelGrants.description: Study Opponent's dodge bonus increases to +3.

levelGrants.name: Make Them Bleed
levelGrants.description: A damaging slashing hit causes ongoing bleeding until treated or its duration expires; multiple wounds stack, while creatures without discernible anatomies are immune.

levelGrants.name: The Crowd Goes Wild
levelGrants.description: After Roar of the Crowd is active, consecutive damaging blows gain an escalating morale damage bonus that resets to +2 after a miss.

classes/knight-protector-322.name: Knight Protector
classes/knight-protector-322.proficiencyText: Knight protectors gain proficiency with tower shields.

codeOfConduct.trigger: Willingly and knowingly violates the code for no adequate reason
codeOfConduct.note: The source removes all supernatural class features; these are the two supernatural features in this class record.

levelGrants.name: Defensive Stance
levelGrants.description: At the start of a turn while within 5 feet of an ally with fewer Hit Dice, the knight protector can transfer up to 2 AC to that ally, lowering his own AC by the same amount; the maximum increases every three levels.

levelGrants.name: Shining Beacon
levelGrants.description: Allies within 10 feet gain +4 morale on saves against fear while the knight protector is not helpless.

levelGrants.name: Best Effort
levelGrants.description: Once per day, declared before a skill check, the knight protector gains a +2 bonus on that check; the bonus increases every three levels.

levelGrants.name: Iron Will
levelGrants.description: The knight protector gains Iron Will as a bonus feat.

levelGrants.name: Supreme Cleave
levelGrants.description: The knight protector may take a 5-foot step between attacks while using Cleave or Great Cleave.

levelGrants.name: Defensive Stance
levelGrants.description: Defensive Stance's maximum AC transfer increases to 3.

levelGrants.name: Best Effort
levelGrants.description: Best Effort's skill-check bonus increases to +3.

levelGrants.name: No Mercy
levelGrants.description: The knight protector can make one extra attack of opportunity per round; this stacks with Combat Reflexes.

levelGrants.name: Defensive Stance
levelGrants.description: Defensive Stance's maximum AC transfer increases to 4.

levelGrants.name: Best Effort
levelGrants.description: Best Effort's skill-check bonus increases to +4.

levelGrants.name: No Mercy
levelGrants.description: No Mercy increases to two extra attacks of opportunity per round.

levelGrants.name: Defensive Stance
levelGrants.description: Defensive Stance's maximum AC transfer increases to 5.

levelGrants.name: Retributive Attack

resource.recoveryText: Never more than one retributive attack per round.

levelGrants.description: When an ally is rendered helpless or unconscious, the knight protector can make a retributive attack against the creature that felled the ally, adding Charisma bonus to the attack and +10 damage on a hit. Daily uses equal Charisma bonus (minimum one), never more than once per round.
